g.title: mask/jitter 兩端風險

g.data-semantic-relation: turn reconstruction mismatch into a candidate
g.data-must-show: tiny defect 小於 feature stride | ROI/illumination drift | 缺件/關係錯誤圖示 | HOLD 指向專用驗證
g.data-not-claim: 共享 feature reconstruction 自動驗證缺件或關係規則。
g.title: 微小、漂移與邏輯題
